title: Tim Baker ON Tour This Christmas: Small Halls and Holiday Songs
summary: Acclaimed singer-songwriter Tim Baker is coming to Harmony Hall for an intimate evening of music and storytelling. Celebrated frontman of Hey Rosetta!, Tim has built a incredible solo career defined by soaring melodies, poetic lyrics, and unforgettable live performances. This special tour brings his songs into small, historic venues—making for a very special concert experience.
